value.rationale: Uniform over every triple of spatial sites and every prime p>=5, this is a complete optimal/worst row-pair design classification within the natural finite quadratic-chirp MUB measurement family. It gives sharp nonzero singular-value conditioning and exactly six choices at either extreme for every chosen reference outcome, plus a sharp large-prime instability law. The value lies in universal support-independent design geometry and counts, not a claim that three-root balancing is itself new or that 2 observations recover 3 unknown coefficients.
